abstract.p: FICTIONAL TEST ABSTRACT about a plastic-eating enzyme.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Plastic waste is a growing problem. INTRO_MARKER.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We tested 48 enzyme variants at 25 degrees Celsius. METHODS_MARKER.

sec.title: Statistics
sec.p: Each test was repeated three times.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The best variant broke down 90 percent of the sample in 10 hours. RESULTS_MARKER.
